title: In an enterprise having a non-deterministic LLM giving you different answers is far less acceptable.
description:
🤔 What happens when the creative, unpredictable nature of LLMs clashes with the corporate world's demand for consistency?

In the consumer space, we've gotten used to the non-deterministic behavior of AI—ask a question twice, and you might get two different answers.

But as Tessl Founder and CEO, Guy Podjarny, points out, this is a major hurdle in the enterprise space. When a company invests heavily in software, they expect reliability and predictable outcomes every single time. The challenge for builders is to manage customer expectations and clearly define the boundary conditions of what these powerful models can achieve within a business context.

Learn more about how Tessl is solving this with Spec Driven Development.

#EnterpriseAI #LLMs #SpecDrivenDev
